_about: Measured SFX practice of the CRED Money reference (69.06 s), one rule per VISUAL BEAT TYPE. offset_s = where the sound's align point sits relative to the visual anchor frame (negative = before). level.rel_bed_lu = SFX max momentary loudness minus the music bed's median momentary loudness over the 2 s before (calibrated so each cue's in-band peak matches the reference, scripts: proto2/calibrate.py --hybrid). level.rel_film_lu = SFX max momentary loudness minus the film's integrated loudness (reference -16.9 LUFS). Tags: [C] certain (measured directly), [L] likely, [G] guess.

global.voiceover: none [C] (Silero VAD max p=0.31 on the mix; positive control: our VO mixed 9 dB under this music is flagged in 82% of frames)
global.sfx_count: 28 discrete SFX in 69 s = 0.41/s; never more than 2 starts in any 1 s window [C]
global.text_entrance: NO dedicated SFX on any of the 9 text entrances; text rides a transition sound or nothing [C, SFX-layer spectrogram]
global.ui_cards: NO UI ticks/clicks/pops anywhere (bank cards, tablet, phone UI are silent) [C]
global.mono_vs_wide: transition whooshes are MONO (side-mid -18 to -33 dB) [C]; beds, swells and shimmers are wide (side-mid -4 to +4.6 dB) [C]
global.band_strategy: the score is dark above 6 kHz (-31 to -36 dB of total energy in grooves) so whooshes/air/glints own 3-15 kHz and can sit 11-27 LU under the bed in loudness yet read clearly [C]
global.music_vs_picture: music drops land MID-SHOT (29.00 s and 51.45 s, no cut within 1 s) [C]; cuts are tied to SFX, not to drops; 6 of 10 hard cuts fall 64-97 ms after a strong musical onset (chance ~1e-4) [L: editorial habit or a ~2-frame A/V offset in the upload, cannot tell which]
global.silence: two deliberate silences: 0-0.54 s head and a 0.15 s dead gap (4.10-4.25 s) between the drawing foley's hard stop and the reveal swell [C]

draw_open.dur: until the drawing completes, then HARD stop (no fade-out tail)

pre_reveal_gap.evidence: 4.10-4.25 s broadband < -85 dBFS between foley stop (4.05) and swell onset (4.23) [C]

reveal.evidence: onset 4.23, peak 5.38, end 5.90; flowers pop in at 5.17 (peak +0.2 s); 40-2000 Hz [C]

nature_bed.evidence: 4.3-6.3 kHz band 5.31-10.29 s under the flower/bird scene, 2.1 s in, 2.9 s out [C]

creature_move.evidence: bird motion onset 7.17, flutter 7.24-7.64 s, 7-15 kHz [C]

creature_voice.evidence: 4 chirps 8.27/8.58/8.91/9.28 s (spacing 0.31-0.37 s ~ quarter-note triplets), each ~0.1-0.23 s, pitch 3564->3386->3262->3149 Hz (about a semitone down each) [C]; level trimmed 2 dB under calibration because the ref bump is +3.8 LU vs ours +7.7 [L]

lens_arrive.evidence: lens edge enters 9.67, swell 9.69-10.43, peak 10.10, 86-904 Hz [C]

groove_in_cut.rule: start the groove (first sub/808 hit) 0.2 s BEFORE the first hard cut into the new world
groove_in_cut.evidence: first sub 13.25-13.30 s, hard cut 13.458 s [C]

foil_shimmer.evidence: holo band cut 13.458; partials C7/E7/G7 2095/2641/3117 Hz + G6 1570 from ~14.12 s, sustained to ~16.6 s with tremolo [C]; note the ref's shimmer is a C-major triad over an Eb track (not key-matched) [C]; we recommend key-matched partials [G]

whip_cut.evidence: whips 3-5 (10 ms envelopes): 20-30 ms tick, 30-50 ms gap, 0.24-0.26 s flat 3-15 kHz noise plateau ending 25/42/75 ms before the cut frame; whip 3 also has an answer plateau 80 ms after the cut [C]. Variant (whips 1-2): plateau straddles the cut (starts 90-110 ms before) [C]

camera_pullback_reveal.evidence: pull-back through columns 21.67-22.17; riser 21.53-22.29 peak 21.96, 5-15 kHz [C]

place_tone.evidence: hard cut 32.542 to lighthouse; 126 Hz tone (+252/379 harmonics) from ~32.75 s for ~3.7 s [C]; gull-like calls 34.5-35.8 s [L: identity of the sound is a guess]

riser_into_cut.evidence: 250-600 Hz tonal riser 35.13-36.40 peaking 35.72, cut 35.75 [C]; exact pitch path not tracked [L]

submerge.evidence: dissolve to underwater 38.96; 39.04-39.59, slow 0.45 s rise, 345-2370 Hz, flatness 0.52 [C]

glint.evidence: seal settles 49.75 -> sparkle 50.24-50.95 (3 bursts, 2.1-12.5 kHz); pearl glint 42.58-44.0 partials 3.5-5.3 kHz [C]

music_drop.rule: land the drop INSIDE a held or slowly moving shot (not on a cut); a 0.5 s sub-free gap precedes it
music_drop.evidence: drop 2 sub returns 51.45-51.50 after a sub gap 50.9-51.4 s; picture is a held seal (frame diff < 0.003) [C]

object_slide_text.evidence: bill wraps phone + text 56.11; whoosh 56.12-56.72, 3-15 kHz [C]

logo_bloom.evidence: logo ring ripple 61.83; bloom 61.88-62.47, peak 62.23, partials Eb3 Bb3 Eb4 Eb5 F5 Bb5 Eb6 F6 [C]

wordmark.rule: let the score's outro section change carry it (outro hit 63.35, wordmark 63.43-63.60)

end_button.rule: anchor = start of the logo fade-out; two last 808 hits, then a pitched bell chord (in key) with 8th-note (0.24 s) echoes decaying -11.6 dB/s for ~2 s

ours_object_signatures._note: ORIGINAL sounds for our film's subjects, built in the same language (one signature sound per object, nature/world foley, no UI clicks). Levels: start from the closest measured beat type. rel_bed_lu here is a [G] starting level (these sounds are not in the reference): set by ear against the measured neighbours (whips -13, place tone -9, glint -17..-1.5).
